feedback_insert_as_coach.name: feedback_insert_as_coach
feedback_insert_as_coach.withCheck:
feedback.coach_id = (select auth.uid()) and exists (
    select 1 from public.submissions s
    join public.enrolments e on e.id = s.enrolment_id
    where s.id = feedback.submission_id and e.coach_id = (select auth.uid())
  )

profiles_select_enrolment_counterpart.name: profiles_select_enrolment_counterpart
profiles_select_enrolment_counterpart.using:
exists (
        select 1 from public.enrolments e
        where (e.student_id = (select auth.uid()) and e.coach_id = profiles.id)
           or (e.coach_id = (select auth.uid()) and e.student_id = profiles.id)
      )

students_select_by_coach.name: students_select_by_coach
students_select_by_coach.using:
exists (
        select 1 from public.enrolments e
        where e.student_id = students.user_id and e.coach_id = (select auth.uid())
      )

media_assets_select_library.name: media_assets_select_library
media_assets_select_library.using:
exists (
        select 1 from public.library_items li
        where li.active
          and (li.demo_media_id = media_assets.id or li.backing_track_media_id = media_assets.id)
      )

media_assets_select_submission.name: media_assets_select_submission
media_assets_select_submission.using: exists (select 1 from public.submissions s where s.media_id = media_assets.id)

media_assets_select_feedback_reply.name: media_assets_select_feedback_reply
media_assets_select_feedback_reply.using: exists (select 1 from public.feedback f where f.reply_media_id = media_assets.id)

media_assets_ready_is_playable.name: media_assets_ready_is_playable
media_assets_ready_is_playable.value: "media_assets"."status" <> 'ready' or ("media_assets"."src" is not null and "media_assets"."peaks_src" is not null and "media_assets"."duration_sec" is not null)
